name: Preserved lemon
description: Lemons packed in salt for a month until the peel goes soft and the flavour turns savoury.

tcm.note: Read with lemon; the cure adds warmth.

histamine.note: A month-long salt ferment on citrus — both mechanisms.

nutrition.highlight: the peel is the part you use

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.
